_comment: Substrate-version sentinel for bwipp-rs. The QR Code family and Data Matrix family delegate 2D layout to upstream Rust crates. A bump of either crate can silently change our output: same input, different module pattern. The substrate-dimension drift net (`integration::substrate_rows_match_bwip_js_dimensions`) catches dim changes; this sentinel catches any version bump so the human signing off the bump consciously checks whether the substrate-dim net still passes against bwip-js. If you bump the crate version intentionally, update both this file AND the substrate-dim corpus / qrcode_::substrate_baseline_pixs_for_hello / datamatrix_::substrate_baseline_for_hello_world tests.

qrcode.rationale: QR Code family substrate. Mask tie-breaks differ from BWIPP — documented compatibility exception in COMPATIBILITY_EXCEPTIONS.md §1.

datamatrix.rationale: Data Matrix family substrate. Size policy can differ from BWIPP for long-ish text — documented Open Risk in AUDIT.md §9.
